segments.segment_summary: A person wearing gloves is kneeling in the grass and using a tool to tighten or repair a strand of a barbed wire fence.

key_moments.caption: A person kneels while using a fence stretcher tool on a barbed wire fence.
The person continues to adjust the tool attached to the fence.

segments.segment_summary: A man introduces a video where he will film his friend riding a four-wheeler through the woods. The video then shows the friend riding the red four-wheeler along a trail, filmed from a following vehicle.

key_moments.caption: A man in a black beanie speaks to the camera, introducing the video from inside a vehicle.
The camera pans to another man in a green shirt and baseball cap, who waves.
A man on a red four-wheeler starts driving down a grassy hill into the woods.
The four-wheeler navigates up a dirt path surrounded by dense trees.
The man on the four-wheeler drives through an open grassy field bordered by trees.
